mapper.select: SELECT d.dev_id FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.dev_id=#{id}

SELECT d.dev_id,d.mng_no,d.dev_nm,CASE WHEN d.vndr_ptnr_id IS NULL THEN '자사' ELSE v.ptnr_nm END AS affiliation_name, d.vndr_ptnr_id AS vendor_id,coalesce(s.bsn_part_id,d.bsn_part_id) AS bsn_part_id, coalesce(s.pstn_cd,d.pstn_cd) AS pstn_cd,coalesce(s.emp_se_cd,d.emp_se_cd) AS emp_se_cd, coalesce(s.duty_se_cd,d.duty_se_cd) AS duty_se_cd,d.main_job_cd AS job_cd,d.grd_cd, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist h WHERE h.dev_id=d.dev_id AND h.work_stts_cd IN ('PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND h.bgn_dt < to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND (h.end_dt IS NULL OR h.end_dt >=to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM'))) AS on_leave FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr v ON v.ptnr_id=d.vndr_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cst.mth_cst s ON s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=#{month} WHERE ((d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.hire_dt IS NULL OR d.hire_dt <to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month') AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt >=to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM'))) OR s.dev_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cst.cst_aloc c WHERE c.dev_id=d.dev_id AND c.cst_ym=#{month})) ORDER BY d.dev_id

SELECT d.dev_id,s.slry_amt,s.alwnc_amt,s.sins_cmpny_amt,s.sins_emp_amt,s.whtax_amt, s.rtrpay_acml_amt,s.real_pay_amt,s.indv_lbr_cst_amt, coalesce(e.team_expns_amt,0)::bigint AS team_expns_amt, coalesce(e.project_expns_amt,0)::bigint AS project_expns_amt FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN cst.mth_cst s ON s.dev_id=d.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.expns_amt) FILTER(WHERE x.expns_item_cd='TEAM') AS team_expns_amt, sum(x.expns_amt) FILTER(WHERE x.expns_item_cd!='TEAM') AS project_expns_amt FROM cst.drct_expns x WHERE x.dev_id=d.dev_id AND x.expns_ym=#{month}) e ON true ORDER BY d.dev_id

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,a.prj_id,p.prj_nm,p.cntrct_ty_cd,a.bgn_dt,a.end_dt FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM')+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >=to_date(#{month},'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY a.asgn_id
